tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro rnam gsum gyi gdams pa bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la/ /nyon mongs lam du byed pa
༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro rnam gsum gyi gdams pa bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la/ /nyon mongs lam du byed pa

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro rnam gsum gyi gdams pa bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la/ /nyon mongs lam du byed pa yod/ /bde bas bde ba 'grub 'gyur zhing*/ /'dod chags kyis ni 'dod chags dag /su ka sidha'i zhal na re/ /

gzhan lus lam du len pa la/ /rig ma brtag cing dgug pa dang*/ /bde ba sgom pa gsum du bzhed/ /dang po rig ma brtag pa ni/ /dpral bar sme ba dkar po yod/ /de ni bud+dha bzang mor bzhed/ /nag po yod na rdo rje'i rigs/ /ser po rat+na sngon po las/ /dmar po yod pa pad+ma'i rigs/ /kun kyang rnam snang rigs la byed/ /lte bar sme ba yod pa dang*/ /dpral bar rtse gsum yod pa ni/ /rin chen 'byung ldan rigs su 'dod/ /de la'ang nang tshan rigs lnga yod/ /mgrin pa'i dbus su sme ba can/ /thabs kyi reg na mi bzod pa/ /'od dpag med pa'i rigs su 'dod/ /rna ba g.yon par sme ba can/ /don yod grub pa'i rigs yin gsungs/ /nu 'phrag dbus su sme bas mtshan/ /mi 'khrugs pa yi rigs yin te/ kha dog bya ba mi 'dra lnga/ /kun la yod de nyer lnga yin/ /gzhan yang dkar po bud+dha'i rigs/ /dkar la dmar ba pad+ma'i rigs/ /las kyi rigs dang rdo rje'i rigs/ /gnyis ka sngo bsangs yin zhes gsungs/ /sha mdog dmar ba rin chen rigs/ /bud+dha'i rigs ni bde ba bul/ /'khul ba bzang ste zlos pa sla/ / rat+na de dang 'dra ba las/ /'dzin pa sla ba'i yon tan yod/ pad+ma'i rigs ni bde ba myur/ /chags par byed la'ang bsngags pa yin/ /las rigs bde ba brtan pa dang*/ /rdo rje'i rigs ni gsal la dwangs/ /'di gnyis rjes ni bzang bar 'dod/ /༈ gnyis pa dgug par bya ba ni/ /mi bskyod pa la gzugs brnyan bya/ /rak+ta dang ni ghi hang gi /ming rus bris la snying khar gzhug /zangs kyi khab bam rtags kyis ni/ /bha gar bskul zhing zhag bdun bsgrub/ /lte ba'i 'khor lo bcug nas ni/ /gnas pa med pa rnam gsum sgom/ /chags pas dwangs ma 'dzag par bsam/ /de yang yi ge lnga la stim/ /a ha ri ni sa che ge mo khug / rnam shes breng breng dung dung*/ /bdag gis dbang du bsdus/ /a ha ri ni sa/ zhag bdun bar du sgrub nas ni/ /sngags kyis btab pa'i bza' btung

byin/ /des ni dbang du 'du bar nges/ /gsum pa bde ba sgom pa ni/ /dbab dang bzung dang zlog pa dang*/ /dgram dang rlung dang bsre ba dang*/ /ye shes chen por bskyel ba'o/ kha cig 'dod yon lnga po la/ /rim bzhin slob par 'dod mod kyang*/ /dus gcig dag tu 'byung ba'i phyir/ /cig car slob pa bzang bar bzhed/ /cung zad srub cing rtsol ba na/ /nor bu hūṃ gyis bkag par bsam/ / 'gyur ba bzhi yis 'dzin pa yin/ /zin pas dka' na thig le ni/ /hūṃ gis phul nas hūṃ gis 'dren/ /spyi bor han han bstim par bsam/ /sprug cing gling bzhi 'phangs ba dang*/ /gnyis ka'i bo dhi zhu bar bya/ /de nas bdun srub rgya mtsho sbyar/ /huṃ gis drag tu drangs par bya/ /shes rab 'od du zhu nas ni/ /rdo rje'i lam nas rang lus khyab/ /'ol ma se'i mdog 'dra ba/ /rang nyid bkrag mdangs rgyas par mos/ /de'i chos 'byung dbus su ni/ khyur khyur nyams su myong nas kyang*/ /zug ngur bcas pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje thal mo pus btsug gnyis/ /bzlog pa'i las la bsngags pa yin/ /lcags 'bar dang ni re mos phra/ /dgram pa'i man ngag yin par bzhed/ /thig le rlung la bsre ba'i phyir/ / bum can tshar 'ga' sgom par bya/ /dbyings su bskyel bar byed pa ni/ /sems ni mi rtog nam mkha' 'dra/ /snang ba bden med sgyu ma bzhin/ /rlung gi yon tan sems la thim/ gsang sngags gnad kyi gdams pa ni/ /skal med rnams la sba bar bya/ /a+thi+-i/ 1 na mo gu ru/ rdza'i sbal ba'i nang du ming rus bris la gzhug yungs dkar bdun nang du gzhug bdun sbal pa'i 'og tu bcug /rang phag mo'i thugs ka nas pho nya mang po sprul/ khams gsum dbang du bsdus par bsam la ngag bcad de/ swahā sbal sha khol/ tsag tsag dung dung*/ 'dur 'dur yed yed/ ch+gai mo'i tsit+ta dkrug /bdag gis dbang du gyur cig /ces sems ma g.yengs bar rab zhag gcig /'bring gny-is/ tha ma gsum/

rmi lam du bud med 'du ba/ khrom 'tshogs pa/ gter rnyed pa sogs 'byung ngo*/ /las spyor ni nyi ma dmar thag chod pa ni/ rdzas la sngags stong tsam bzlas/ rab phyi'i nyungs dkar gtor ba/ 'bring sha la brlan pa tsam dang*/ tha ma'ang sbal pa lus la thebs na the tshom med/ lus 'khyor ba dang/ sems mi gnas pa yong nyin yod/ de la 'dod pa spyod pas sel/ grol bar 'dod na gangs chu grang mo lus la rgyag /sngags mgo mjug bzlog /sbal ba bcag /ming rus spos chus khrus byas pas grol bar 'gyur ro/ /a+thi+-i/2 na mo gu ru/ klod dang 'gyur bzhi gzhom pa ste/ /'dzin pa rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /rdo rje khu tshur thal mo pus btsug dang*/ /rtsal sprug khong 'dren rta zhon tshul/ /'dren pa'i 'khrul 'khor rnam lnga'o/ /dgram pa'i 'khrul 'khor rnam dgu ni/ /dang por mgo lcogs 'phar sprug bya/ /gnyis ka rkang lag re mos 'khrab/ /gsum pa dpung 'dzin zhi sprug rdebs/ /bzhi pa mkhal mnan pho ba bskor/ /lnga drug lag sprug gan rkyal 'khrab/ /bdun pa sug bzhi g.yas g.yon 'then/ /brgyad dgu brkyang bskum gan rkyal rgyangs/ / lus kyi 'dug stangs 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /yang dag ting 'dzin bskyed pa 'di/ / mkha' 'gro bde ba'i dngos grub dang*/ /dpal ldan gang ga dha ri dang*/ /ḍā ki kun du bzang mo yi/ /dgongs pa gcig tu gung spros pa/ /rtogs ldan zhang sgom gsung bzhin du/ /lhag chad med par bkod pa'o/ /a+thi+-i/3 'gyur ba bzhi ni/ rgya mtsho ri rab la gcer pa/ gling bzhi dbang du bsdu ba/ dar po che rang gnas su 'char ba/ nyi zla nam mkhar bzung ba ste bzung pa'o/ /bzlog pa ni/ rdo rje thal mo spyi bor 'then la/ rlung sems nam mkhar 'phang pa'o/ /yang pus mo dang rdo rje khu tshur btsugs la hag hig hog ces snying kha/ mgrin pa spyi bo rnams su drangs sa ོ / khyab par byed pa la langs te mgo la thal lcag re mos su rdeg pa dang*/ 'phags shing lag pa'ang sprug go

/gnyis pa ni rgur nas rkang lag re mos su 'khrab bo/ /mkha' 'gro su ka sidhi'i gdams pa'o/ /a+thi+-i/ 4 'dzin pa'i klod pa'i man ngag ni/ lus sems khong klod cing srin zhal yan pa'o/ /bzlog pa ni lus sprug ste/ rlung phyir 'phang srin pos 'then/ khu tshur brla la btsugs te 'dren no/ /yang gnyis pa ni/ lag pa gnyis kyi phan tshun du dpung pa bzung nas/ smad kyi rlung khong nas drangs so*/ /'gram pa la dang po/ lag pa gnyis kyis dpung ba bzung la pho khar bsnol bzhi sprug byas nas mchan khung dang 'phongs tshos rdeb pa'o/ /yang khu tshur mkhal ma'i thad du btsugs la 'pho ba bskor/ gsang bar gcog cing g.yas g.yon 'then no/ / yang langs nas lag pa gnyis sprug go /yang cung zad gan rkyal du byas nas sug bzhi 'khrab bo/ /gang ga dha ra'i lugs/ /a+thi+-i/ 5 na mo gu ru/ bo dhi tsit+ta bzung 'dod na/ /chags pa'i dang po dbyings su gzhom/ /rlung yang rang yan lus kyang klod/ /dga' ba'i rang zhal lta bar byed/ /des ni grol bar the tshom med/ /lag pa gcig brkyang gcig shos ni/ khu tshur dpung pa'i thad du bcangs/ /rkang pa gcig shos btsugs nas ni/ / gcig ni rta la 'god tshul byed/ kha spyor stong du 'then par bya/ /gnas su bskyel ba'i man ngag yin/ /yan lag sug bzhi btsugs nas ni/ /g.yas g.yon dbus su rdeg cing 'then/ /gdungs sna la 'jug dpyangs nas ni/ /lus kyang brkyang bskum drag tu bya/ /rtsa mig gnas su 'debs pa yin/ /mkha' 'gro kun tu bzang mo'i lugs/ /a+thi+-i/ 6 na mo gu ru/ gsang sngags mgyogs byed pho nya'i lam/ /blo ngan rnams la mi bstan te/ /dug chen ha la ha la 'gyur/ /dper na bcud chen 'o mi nga*/ / gdug pa'i sbrul la blud pa 'dra/ /'ga' zhig chos la skur ba 'debs/ yang na chos kyi gang zag brlag /de bas snod ldan 'tshol ba gces/ /rig ma mtshan ldan rnyed sla ste/ /rten gyi gang zag shin tu dkon/ /rab ni mngon shes stobs kyi brtag

/'bring ni mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan tshol/ /tha ma rten gyi gang zag ste/ / bla mas gcig gsung sgrub nus shing*/ /chos kyi phyir du dka' ba spyod/ /ngo tsha che zhing sdig pa 'dzem/ /brtson 'grus che zhing gsang thub pa/ /chos phyir 'bad med gtong nus na/ /skal ldan de rang yin zha ེ sa gsung*/ /'di la rig ma brtag pa dang*/ /rtsa 'tshol ba dang rtsa brkyed dang*/ /sbyangs dang las la sbyar ba dang*/ / mthar thug sgom pa drug tu bzhed/ /de la dang po brtag pa ni/ /dung can ma ni bde ba myur/ /de yi dpral ba mgrin pa dang*/ /snying kha lte ba skye gnas te/ / gnas lnga de dag gang rung du/ /dung dang 'dra ba'i ri mo yod/ /glang chen ma ni sme ba smug /staung nyid bsgom na bogs su che/ /pad+ma can ni bde ba rgyas/ /lus la thig le'i ri mo 'byung*/ /ri mo dgur por rgyab sprod du/ /yod na ri dwags can ma yin/ /bde ba mi che shin tu brtan/ /ri mo can la ṭi mi ni/ /drang po phal cher gsum sgrigs yod/ /gnas su dkyil ba shin tu sla/ /lcug phran ma la lnga yod de/ /gsal nyams mthar dbus med par 'char/ /chos 'byung ma ni chos 'byung gzugs/ /zag bcas bde ba shugs dang ldan/ /gnyis pa na mi 'tshol ba ni/ / spyi bor gla rtsi tsan+dan dmar/ /til mar gsum po bsres pas mnye/ /rgyab bstan steng du khal bsnol dang*/ /shing leb dang ni ska rags bsdams/ /k+ṣu yig gnas su 'phying bu bzhag /des ni rtsa de rnyed par 'gyur/ /sbom na pun da ri ka yi/ /rtsa ba dgos te mi rnyed de/ khug chos ba dkar 'o ma dang*/ /ka ra mar gsar rgya tsang tshil/ /chang dang sbyar ba byug na ni/ /phra zhing shin du rno bar 'gyur/ /gsum pa rtsa ni skyed pa la/ /na chen chu bor phyung nas ni/ /dga' ba'i dmar por bcud dug gtso/ kha ru tsha dag shin shin btabs/ /yang na mkha' lding rgya gtsang btags/ / ra mo sha dang dkar gsum dang*/ /thabs shes dam rdzas brten pa yis/ /gnyis ka lus bzung skyed par bya/

/bzhi pa sngon 'gro sbyangs pa ni/ /gzugs snang sgyu mar shes bya zhing*/ /ngag ni las rlung khegs par bya/ /sems ni 'dzin med nam mkha' 'dra/ /ma rtogs 'gro drug sems can la/ /snying rje mkha' khyab sgom pa gces/ /lnga pa las la sbyar ba ni/ /dang po gzugs la lta ba dang*/ /gnyis pa sgra la bslabs pa dang*/ /gsum pa dri zhim bde ba rgyas/ /bzhi pa lus kyi reg bya dang*/ /ro mchog khyad par myong ba ni/ /'khyud dang tsim pa bha gar reg /lnga pa snyoms par 'jug pa yin/ /rtsa sna rig na rkang pa brkyang*/ /thung na phrag par skal ba yin/ /phyogs bzhir rdo rjes btsal bya zhing*/ /cig shos kyis kyang 'og rlung bskum/ /srog rtsol mnan pas gter bar bya/ /'pho 'pho 'dra na klod par gces/ /mig ni gyen du lta bar bya/ /cig shos sked pa nyag gis btang*/ /rlung ni gsang bar phul ba na/ /bde ba zin par the tshom med/ /nyams te yal du mi 'jug par/ /yang yang dbab par bya ba las/ /bde ba klod par mi nus na/ / lag pa sogs kyi klod par bzhed/ /rtsa sprug byed cing khong nas 'dren/ /mkhal mnan pho ba bskor ba dang*/ /lag pa sprug cing gan rgyal 'khrab/ /gnas su bzlog cing gnas su khrems/ /drug pa mthar thug sgom pa ni/ /rig pa dwangs snyigs phye ba na/ /bde ba rang gi rig pa tsam*/ /rig pa gsal stong brjod du med/ /nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam par bsre/ /mkha' 'gro gang ga dha ra dang*/ /rje btsun rin chen lha mo gnyis/ / yi dam zhal gzigs dngos grub brnyes/ /gdams pa mkha' 'gro'i bstan pa yin/ /a+thi+-i/ 7 na mo gu ru/ man ngag zab mo smin mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma sangs rgyas zhabs la 'dud*/ /mgyogs byed las kyi phyag rgya'i lam/ /mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag lta bu la/ /kun du bzang mo'i zhal na re/ /sed+ge'i 'o ma 'dra zhes gsungs// dper na sed+ge'i 'o ma ste/ /phal ba'i snod du blug pa na/ /snod kyang 'chag la bcud kyang 'bo/ /rin chen snod du blug na ni/

/dri zhim ro mchog lhag par 'phel/ /brten dang rtsa stobs rgyas par 'gyur/ /'dod chags tha mal nyon mongs 'di/ /skye bo kun la dug yin zhing*/ /lam du longs na 'chi med ster/ / dus gsum sangs rgyas byang sems kyi/ /yon tan ma lus thams cad kyang*/ / lhan skyes bde ba che las byung*/ /bde ba kun+da yin pas na/ /las rgya lam du byed pa bsngags/ /'di la mtshan nyid brtag pa dang*/ /skem dang bde gnas 'tshol ba dang*/ /sad dang las la sbyar ba ste/ /rtses mgo rnam pa lnga ru bzhed/ /dang po rigs ni ma gsungs kyang*/ /brten rgyu rung ste de ltar yang*/ /rab 'bring tha ma'i khyad par yod/ /mchu la bha ga brtag par bya/ /srab dang rgyas dang bar mas yin/ kha yis dkyus la cig shos brtag /dgu la sor lnga lhag pa spangs/ /bcu drug la yang 'khyud gang dang*/ /rtsal rdzogs na yang nyi shu'o/ /de bas ring ba ma brten no/ /man chad bsten du rung ba yin/ /bde bas mtshan nyid mig la brtag / mig dkyus ring zhing mig 'bras snum/ /sri la 'dzum pa yod na bzang*/ /nu ma dang ni skra dag las/ /gus dang mi gus brtag tu rung*/ /li na bzang ste ser na 'bring*/ /nag cing rtsub pa tha ma yin/ /zlum po bzang ste rno ba 'bring*/ /shin tu 'phyang na mi bzang ngo*/ /ol mdud sbom zhing snying gi spu/ /'dug na gsang sgrogs thub pa 'ong*/ /chos 'byung ba spu spangs pa rab/ /ser kham 'bring dang nag po ngan/ /rus sbal dkar zhing nang dmar ma/ /de ni mchog tu 'dod pa yin/ /smug pa 'bring yin gzhan ni spangs/ /lce dang snying la kha dog dang*/ / mchan khung las ni ba spu brtag /skem ni rgya skyegs khu ba ste/ /chu rtse'i me la skol nas ni/ /spang rgyan me tog btab pa 'thung*/ /gnyer po che ni gser gyis bsres/ /bha gar chu bcag btab pa dang*/ /ber ga sor ni brgyad pa yi/ tshang ra bcos so dal bus brdung*/ /gsum pa bde gnas 'tshol ba ni/ /bcos ma'i 'ob las phyi dang ni/

/nang du yang yang reg par bya/ /gang la ngo gcig byung ba der/ /rdo rje dbyings phyug yod pa yin/ /bzhi pa sad par bya ba ni/ /mig ni gyen bstan lag pa gnyis/ /pus mo dag la bkab par bya/ /hūṃ yig ring po ring po'i mthar/ /hig ni mang du brgyud pa yin/ /de 'dra yang yang sbyangs nas ni/ /'og sgo 'byed 'dzum sbyor ba las/ /gsang ba'i gnas su btsud par bya/ / de nas lan gcig lcam pa yi/ /rkang gi rtsal te yang yang drangs/ /'byed 'dzum sbyor bas yang yang dbyung*/ /'di la rtags su thon na ni/ /dngos gzhi'i las la 'jug par byed/ /lnga pa las la sbyar ba ni/ /dang por glu dang dga' tshig nyan/ /de rjes lus kyi cha la brtag /de rjes ku re 'khrig tshig dang*/ /de nas rtse 'jo sna tshogs dang*/ /de 'og phyi yi reg bya ste/ /lag bcings mo dang 'khyud pa dang*/ /so dang sen mo 'debs pa dang*/ /bde reg byed cing pha rol 'drud/ /de nas snyoms par 'jug pa ste/ /chags spyod bdun du bzhed pa yin/ /rus sbal 'gros kyi 'bebs par bya/ /skad cig de la phrad gzhom dang*/ /steng pa gser gling gnas su bzhag /des ni brten par 'gyur ba yin/ /rta zhon tshul gyis gnas su bskyal/ /sug bzhi g.yas g.yon 'then nas ni/ /brkyang bskum bya zhing gan rkyal rgyangs/ /de 'dras rtsa mig dag tu 'debs/ /lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun las/ /sems ni mi rtog mtha' dbus med/ /ngag ni rang babs 'gro 'ongs bral/ /chags med mnyam par bzhag pa las/ /bde ba zhen med ngo mtshar che/ /dbyings su skyil ba'i gdams ngag yin/ /a+thi+-i/ 8 na mo gu ru/ gsang sngags bde ba lam byed ni/ /rnam rtog nyid kyi rnam rtog dang*/ /srid pa nyid kyi srid pa dag /ji ltar me yi tshig pa la/ /me yi yang ni gdung bar bya/ /de bzhin 'dod chags mes tshig pa/ /'dod chags mes ni gdung bar bya/ /zhes gsung gnad du che na yang*/ /las rgya brten pa mi nus na/

/yid kyi sgom nas sbyor bar bzhed/ /snang stong sgyu ma lta bu la/ /'bad rtsol med par byang bar gces/ /gzhan du thar med gnas su lhung*/ /rang shar lha sku'i lam khyer bya/ / tshogs zlum byin gyis rlobs pa yin/ /rtsa yig sngags kyis byin gyis rlobs/ / bar chad mi 'jug lam du 'gro/ /gzung du med cing thob pa med/ /byar med nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam/ /chos nyid 'od gsal rtogs par 'gyur/ /bla ma shangs pa chen po des/ /ma rgyud spyi yi rdzogs rim gnad/ /mkha' 'gro rnam pa gsum gyis ni/ /zhal gdams thugs la chud par mdzod/ /rtogs ldan zhang sgom chos seng gis/ /bla ma chen po de la ni/ /lus kyi zhabs rtog phul ba dang*/ /sgrub pa nyams myong shar ba yin/ /sgrub pa'i me tog spungs pa'i dus/ / pad+ma steng du thugs bcud gnang*/ /de la bla ma rin chen gyis/ /rkang thag spangs te gsan pa yin/ /byin rlabs brgyud ldan man ngag 'di/ / slob bu'i don du gsal bar bkod/ /mkha' 'gro rnam gsum gyi man ngag rdzogs so// //maṅga laṃ/ /
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 282 -- PAGE 283 -- PAGE 274 -
